description: Labelled cases for M8 ingestion structure (ADR docs/design/adr-m8-ingestion-structure.md section 6.1), scored by scripts/eval_ingestion_structure.py (and the world_time list also by tests/unit/test_world_time_eval.py). Synthetic, no real data. world_time: one extracted fact each, through extraction/world_time.world_time_of. content is the model's English sentence; source_text, when present, is the owner's own words (Tamil or Tanglish allowed). said_at is the anchor (default: anchor below), in tz. expect is the start day and precision, or null for unknown. supersession: an active old memory and a new fact (the extractor's raw item, read by extraction/llm.py's own checks) from trust_tier, at the given embedding similarity, through MemoryManager._process_fact with the M8 flags on and plain stand-ins for the store; gold.tier is high (applied at once), medium (waits for the owner), low (a review item only), none or merged; gold.same_attribute says whether the two really are one attribute changing; gold.world_end whether the old fact must get a valid_until. links: one message's raw facts through MemoryManager.store_facts and services/memory/typed_links.py; gold lists the links by fact position; existing makes one fact an exact duplicate of an earlier memory of that tier. decisions: capture cases (the capture spine's decision rules and its owner-only gate: gold.candidates) and moves cases (a decision moved by actors through the owner routes, a memory review, a create or the system's mirror; gold.final and gold.confirmed).
